answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded-identity ledger: each agent name is backed by a slashable stake plus a per-epoch proof-of-work receipt. New identities start at zero weight, so minting a thousand fake peers buys nothing until each independently pays copper-priced registration and a stake lock. One wallet backs only one live identity, so stake cannot be rented twice. A double-signing identity is seized, keeping the attacker's marginal cost at full stake per extra voice instead of decaying. A beacon slot each epoch burns compute, and honest nodes reject a lotus-badged cluster sharing funding.
